command: Rat pancreatic lipase Pnlip has phospholipase A1 or lipoprotein lipase activity, participates in HDL remodeling or fatty-acid biosynthesis, or positively regulates triacylglycerol lipase activity. Assess each separately using exact term definitions, actual PTN000906454 placement and source identity. PMID:8656075 says pancreatic lipase poorly hydrolyzes phospholipids; test positional chemistry and retained capacity without converting weak turnover into zero. Lipoprotein lipase requires lipoprotein-bound TG, not arbitrary emulsified TG. Distinguish direct release of fatty acids by hydrolysis from the defined biosynthetic process, and validate any claimed positive regulation against the actual ortholog/source. Do not infer a particular protein from a generic family enzyme name.
